assistAttempts.changedStrategy: Prior Beta evidence already covered burn, commercialization and reporting-quality risk. This run avoided duplicate analysis and used the SEC capital-structure disclosure to isolate a distinct warrant/equity dilution channel and its liquidity tradeoff for Alpha.

learning.strategy: With no owned Beta work, use spare capacity only where a materially distinct source class or causal/risk channel can reduce Alpha uncertainty; do not repeat unchanged prior Beta evidence.
learning.success: Added a primary-source-addressed financing/dilution risk channel for INFQ without assigning Alpha numeric risk or score.
learning.remainingAuthority: Council Alpha retains numeric underwriting, score-risk evidence construction and source-integrity/company-underwriting closure.
